author: Christopher Monhollen (Twillion)
name: Material3D
shortDescription: Unified 3D material behavior — PBR maps, UV scrolling, flipbook and video, glass and clearcoat, full runtime control, and diagnostics that tell you whether it applied.
description:
**Material3D** is the single material behavior for GDevelop 3D objects. It replaces three earlier extensions: **Animated & Custom PBR Material 3D**, **Advanced Materials** and **Advanced 3D Material**.

### What it does
- **PBR texture maps** — albedo, normal, roughness, metalness, ambient occlusion and emissive, assigned from project resources.
- **Animated surfaces** — UV scrolling, spritesheet flipbooks and video playback on any 3D surface.
- **Glass and clearcoat** — transmission, index of refraction, thickness and clearcoat, on an opt-in `MeshPhysicalMaterial` path.
- **Three material classes** — Basic (unlit), Standard (PBR) and Physical, chosen explicitly or automatically.
- **Everything settable at runtime** — all 57 properties have setter actions, including which mesh or material slot is targeted.
- **Diagnostics** — conditions and expressions reporting whether the material applied, to how many meshes, and why it failed. 3D material work otherwise fails silently.

### Not included: BRDF Materials
**BRDF Materials** is deliberately a separate extension. It rewrites the lighting model through a shader patch rather than setting material fields, so the two compose: apply Material3D first, then BRDF Materials on top.

### Defaults changed from the extensions this replaces
**Alpha Mode** and **Rendered Side** now default to **Preserve**. Previously attaching the behavior silently flattened transparency on models that shipped with it.

propertyDescriptors.name: ApplyOnCreation
propertyDescriptors.label: Apply on creation
propertyDescriptors.description: Build and apply the material as soon as the object exists.

propertyDescriptors.name: UpdateMode
propertyDescriptors.label: Update mode
propertyDescriptors.description: When property changes take effect. "Every frame" re-reads every property each frame; "Manual" waits for the Reapply action.

propertyDescriptors.name: CloneMaterials
propertyDescriptors.label: Clone materials
propertyDescriptors.description: Give this object its own copy of the material. Off means edits affect every object sharing it.

propertyDescriptors.name: IncludeChildren
propertyDescriptors.label: Include child meshes
propertyDescriptors.description: Walk the whole model tree, not just the root mesh.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShaderType

propertyDescriptors.description: Which Three.js material to build. "Auto" uses Physical only when transmission or clearcoat is in use, and Standard otherwise.

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: BRDFMaterial
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Applies a custom diffuse BRDF (Lambert, Burley, Oren-Nayar, Minnaert, Toon, Callisto and seven more) by patching the material shader through onBeforeCompile, preserving GDevelop lights, shadows and PBR specular. Composes on top of Material 3D rather than replacing it.
